jcr:content.jcr:title: Fat Loss Guide: 5 Habits That Work
jcr:content.jcr:description: Simple habit-based fat loss strategies for sustainable progress.

articleBody.text:
Fat Loss Without Burnout

Build consistency with manageable calorie deficits, protein-rich meals, and daily movement targets.

  1. Hit protein first
  2. Track portions for two weeks
  3. Walk 8-10k steps daily
  4. Lift weights 3-4x weekly
  5. Prioritize sleep quality
